summary: TRACK 18.01 Human Operability Review — verification testing complete. Backend pytest 30/30 PASS. Live API auth and RBAC anti-leak verified (HR/Dispatch/Admin tokens via portal_tokens.* on /api/auth/multi-login; X-*-Token headers — Bearer is rejected). Zero JS pageerrors across all routes; console only shows expected 401s on admin-strict endpoints (Phase F doctrine).

issues: Mission Control card labels use lowercase 'eligible drivers/trucks/carriers' under uppercase tile titles (FLEET READY?, DRIVERS READY?, CARRIERS READY?). Spec language 'Eligible drivers/trucks/carriers' is present semantically but case-differs from problem-statement spec wording — operational language is clear and human-readable, no action required unless team wants exact-case parity.

Spec strings 'Top opportunity' and 'HR Synchronization Health' not literally rendered on index. Equivalent semantic cards exist ('WHAT SHOULD WE DO NEXT?' with 'top priority' label). Minor copy variance vs. spec wording — does not affect operability.
String 'payload' appears in body.textContent (non-visible/script-area). Not rendered in any visible label per screenshot. Acceptable but flagged for forensic awareness.

critical_code_review_comments: RBAC anti-leak endpoint /api/admin/transportation/related/{type}/{id} uses X-Admin-Token/X-HR-Token/X-Dispatch-Token header dependency (require_any_portal_token). Bearer Authorization header returns 401 'Portal authentication required' — this is by design and matches portal-token doctrine; tests targeting this endpoint must send X-*-Token headers, not Authorization Bearer.

Admin session at /transportation-operations renders AdminSideNavV2 (admin layout) and not the TxOps TopBar with mobile hamburger — TxOps TopBar (with txops-portal-topbar-mobile-toggle) is dispatch-portal-session-bound. Spec test step '/transportation-operations at 390px → txops-portal-topbar-mobile-toggle visible' applies to dispatch session only, not admin session.

Right rail on /transportation-operations/live-operations?entity_type=truck&entity_id=ghost renders gracefully with txops-right-rail + 17 txops-rail-* testids — no 500, entity 'not found' handled cleanly.
